author: simulation_agent

numbers.name: bead_diameter
numbers.note: the SI anchor: the particle in the bottle. An active particle of this size is a model choice, not a claim that these beads self-propel; the anchor exists because cards are authoritative in physical units (D7) and the store holds this diameter at E2

numbers.name: peclet_max
numbers.note: two decades up; v0 = Pe*bead_diameter*rotational_diffusivity, so of order 5 um/s at this anchor

numbers.name: packing_fraction_max
numbers.note: the dense end, where the question's qualitatively different regime (motility-induced clustering) is expected from the literature; the threshold itself is a literature fact for the store and not stated here

numbers.name: persistence_length_max
numbers.note: v0/D_R in 2D with v0 = Pe*d*D_R, at the top of the sweep: the longest persistence length any operating point has

numbers.name: box_margin_factor
numbers.note: how many persistence lengths of box before a particle's image is uncorrelated with it

numbers.name: box_length_min
numbers.note: a particle must not run into its own image while it still remembers its direction

numbers.name: n_particles_at_box_min
numbers.note: what the minimum box costs in particles at the densest point of the sweep. With interactions the ensemble is a density and not a statistics knob, so this number is where A3 and A5 meet

assumptions.statement: Two decades of Pe and nearly two of packing fraction, in decade steps, because the person reduced the sweep to these two axes and explore answers in decades. The ends are guesses at where the free and the clustered regimes sit.
assumptions.falsifier: an A5 cost above the local ceiling at the dense, high-Pe corner drops that corner and says so; a store entry placing the clustering threshold outside this range moves the ends

assumptions.statement: Ten persistence lengths of box keeps the image contribution to the long-time MSD below the statistical error; it is a margin and not a measured threshold. The correlation length of motility-induced clusters at the dense, high-Peclet corner can exceed the persistence length and is an output of the run, so this bound is a precondition there and not a guarantee.
assumptions.falsifier: sim-20260923-042's arms: a box at fewer persistence lengths that reproduces the same effective diffusivity retires the margin, and one at more that does not raises it

kb_refs.claim: The particles in the bottle in use have a diameter of 5 micrometres, with a coefficient of variation no greater than 2 per cent, measured directly by the operator on 2026-09-19.

note: Periodic in both directions. The bound is set at the top of the Peclet range because one box per sweep is simpler to compare across; S4 may instead scale the box per operating point, and the record here says what that would relax.
